sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
General Formulations is a family-owned global manufacturer of pressure-sensitive print media with a cross-platform portfolio of film and laminate solutions headquartered in Sparta, Michigan since 1953.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Sparta, Michigan, USA · Size: $50M-$250M · Products: GF 830 AutoMark Cast Film, GF 765 Rainbow Holographic Film, GF 100, GF 101, GF 102, GF 103

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: General Formulations scores 52 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25), company size (8/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, graffiti resistance, chemical resistance, cleanability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar surfaces clean up with mild detergent, no abrasives, no gloss loss. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (38% similar on media, print, films, film); Mactac (32% similar on films, media, print, film); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (22% similar on films, graphics, graphic, protection). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
